returns.name: toString
returns.description: Returns a string representation of a string.

returns.name: charAt
returns.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

returns.name: charCodeAt
returns.description: Returns the Unicode value of the character at the specified location.

returns.name: concat
returns.description: Returns a string that contains the concatenation of two or more strings.

returns.name: indexOf
returns.description: Returns the position of the first occurrence of a substring.

returns.name: lastIndexOf
returns.description: Returns the last occurrence of a substring in the string.

returns.name: localeCompare
returns.type: { (that: string): number; (that: string, locales?: string | string[], options?: Intl.CollatorOptions): number; (that: string, locales?: Intl.LocalesArgument, options?: Intl.CollatorOptions): number; }
returns.description:
Determines whether two strings are equivalent in the current locale.
Determines whether two strings are equivalent in the current or specified locale.

returns.name: match
returns.type: { (regexp: string | RegExp): RegExpMatchArray | null; (matcher: { [Symbol.match](string: string): RegExpMatchArray | null; }): RegExpMatchArray | null; }
returns.description:
Matches a string with a regular expression, and returns an array containing the results of that search.
Matches a string or an object that supports being matched against, and returns an array
containing the results of that search, or null if no matches are found.

returns.name: replace
returns.type: { (searchValue: string | RegExp, replaceValue: string): string; (searchValue: string | RegExp, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; (searchValue: { [Symbol.replace](string: string, replaceValue: string): string; }, replaceValue: string): string; (searchValue: { [Symbol.replace](string: string, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; }, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; }
returns.description:
Replaces text in a string, using a regular expression or search string.
Passes a string and {@linkcode replaceValue} to the `[Symbol.replace]` method on {@linkcode searchValue}. This method is expected to implement its own replacement algorithm.
Replaces text in a string, using an object that supports replacement within a string.

returns.name: search
returns.type: { (regexp: string | RegExp): number; (searcher: { [Symbol.search](string: string): number; }): number; }
returns.description: Finds the first substring match in a regular expression search.

returns.name: slice
returns.description: Returns a section of a string.

returns.name: split
returns.type: { (separator: string | RegExp, limit?: number): string[]; (splitter: { [Symbol.split](string: string, limit?: number): string[]; }, limit?: number): string[]; }
returns.description: Split a string into substrings using the specified separator and return them as an array.

returns.name: substring
returns.description: Returns the substring at the specified location within a String object.

returns.name: toLowerCase
returns.description: Converts all the alphabetic characters in a string to lowercase.

returns.name: toLocaleLowerCase
returns.description: Converts all alphabetic characters to lowercase, taking into account the host environment's current locale.

returns.name: toUpperCase
returns.description: Converts all the alphabetic characters in a string to uppercase.

returns.name: toLocaleUpperCase
returns.description: Returns a string where all alphabetic characters have been converted to uppercase, taking into account the host environment's current locale.

returns.name: trim
returns.description: Removes the leading and trailing white space and line terminator characters from a string.

returns.name: length
returns.description: Returns the length of a String object.

returns.name: substr
returns.description: Gets a substring beginning at the specified location and having the specified length.

returns.name: valueOf
returns.description: Returns the primitive value of the specified object.

returns.name: codePointAt
returns.description:
Returns a nonnegative integer Number less than 1114112 (0x110000) that is the code point
value of the UTF-16 encoded code point starting at the string element at position pos in
the String resulting from converting this object to a String.
If there is no element at that position, the result is undefined.
If a valid UTF-16 surrogate pair does not begin at pos, the result is the code unit at pos.

returns.name: includes
returns.description:
Returns true if searchString appears as a substring of the result of converting this
object to a String, at one or more positions that are
greater than or equal to position; otherwise, returns false.

returns.name: endsWith
returns.description:
Returns true if the sequence of elements of searchString converted to a String is the
same as the corresponding elements of this object (converted to a String) starting at
endPosition – length(this). Otherwise returns false.

returns.name: normalize
returns.description:
Returns the String value result of normalizing the string into the normalization form
named by form as specified in Unicode Standard Annex #15, Unicode Normalization Forms.

returns.name: repeat
returns.description:
Returns a String value that is made from count copies appended together. If count is 0,
the empty string is returned.

returns.name: startsWith
returns.description:
Returns true if the sequence of elements of searchString converted to a String is the
same as the corresponding elements of this object (converted to a String) starting at
position. Otherwise returns false.

returns.name: padStart
returns.description:
Pads the current string with a given string (possibly repeated) so that the resulting string reaches a given length.
The padding is applied from the start (left) of the current string.

returns.name: padEnd
returns.description:
Pads the current string with a given string (possibly repeated) so that the resulting string reaches a given length.
The padding is applied from the end (right) of the current string.

returns.name: trimEnd
returns.description: Removes the trailing white space and line terminator characters from a string.

returns.name: trimStart
returns.description: Removes the leading white space and line terminator characters from a string.

returns.name: trimLeft
returns.description: Removes the leading white space and line terminator characters from a string.

returns.name: trimRight
returns.description: Removes the trailing white space and line terminator characters from a string.

returns.name: matchAll
returns.description:
Matches a string with a regular expression, and returns an iterable of matches
containing the results of that search.

returns.name: replaceAll
returns.type: { (searchValue: string | RegExp, replaceValue: string): string; (searchValue: string | RegExp, replacer: (substring: string, ...args: any[]) => string): string; }
returns.description: Replace all instances of a substring in a string, using a regular expression or search string.

returns.name: at
returns.description: Returns a new String consisting of the single UTF-16 code unit located at the specified index.
